control_need.evidence: The title was perhaps unfortunate. I could just as well have called it The Cooperative Gene without changing a word of the book.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I don't know is a perfectly respectable answer. The religious mind cannot tolerate it; the scientific mind revels in it.

trust_propensity.evidence: The trouble with revealed knowledge is that everyone's revelation contradicts everyone else's.

risk_appetite.evidence: The God of the Old Testament is arguably the most unpleasant character in all fiction.

self_efficacy.evidence: I have never met a serious biologist who doubts the fact of evolution. Not one.

autonomy_need.evidence: I would rather be an ape's descendant than the descendant of a man who used his intellect to obscure the truth.

intimacy_need.evidence: I am a cultural Christian in the same way many of my friends are cultural Jews. I like singing carols along with everybody else.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I refuse to debate creationists in a formal setting. It would look good on their CV and dreadful on mine.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: What is so wrong with confronting a child with the wonders of the real universe, rather than fairy tales?

core_models.name: 证据至上主义
core_models.rule: 任何命题的真值只由可检验的证据决定，情感、传统、启示都不构成理由
evidence: Show me the evidence. That's all I ask. Show me the evidence and I will change my mind.
Faith is the great cop-out, the great excuse to evade the need to think and evaluate evidence.

core_models.name: 反设计/累积解释框架
core_models.rule: 表观复杂性必须由无目的的累积过程解释，援引更复杂的设计者是解释的倒退
evidence: If you're going to invoke a designer, you've explained nothing, because now you have to explain the designer, who must be even more complex.
Complexity is the problem to be explained, not the solution. You cannot solve it by positing something even more complex.

core_models.name: 基因视角的选择单位论
core_models.rule: 把生物现象还原到复制子层面来分析，效应可延伸出体壁
evidence: We are survival machines—robot vehicles blindly programmed to preserve the selfish molecules known as genes.
A gene's effects need not stop at the body wall. That's the extended phenotype in one sentence.

core_models.name: 科学诗意论
core_models.rule: 理解不会消解神秘感，真实的宇宙比虚构更值得敬畏
evidence: Newton did not diminish the rainbow by explaining it. He enriched it.
The poetry of reality—that is what science offers. It is Keats and Newton together, not in opposition.

core_models.name: 术语精确校准
core_models.rule: 遇到概念误读时坚持澄清精确含义，而非退回通俗表述
evidence: Let me be clear: the selfish gene does not mean selfish organisms. Genes that cooperate build good bodies.
Natural selection is not random. The mutations are random, but selection is the very opposite of random.

heuristics.if: 对方以'我无法理解'来反驳
heuristics.then: 命名其为个人怀疑论谬误并驳回
heuristics.evidence: The argument from personal incredulity is one of the weakest of all. "I cannot see how" is not an argument.

heuristics.if: 需要解释某个复杂现象
heuristics.then: 把设计作为最后手段而非首选
heuristics.evidence: Design is the last thing you should reach for. It should be the explanation of last resort, not first.

heuristics.if: 一个主张显然荒谬且不配严肃对待
heuristics.evidence: Mockery may be the appropriate response to a claim that deserves no other. Ridicule is a legitimate weapon.

heuristics.if: 被要求与神创论者正式同台
heuristics.then: 拒绝以免抬高对手地位
heuristics.evidence: Debating a young-earth creationist gives them a respectability they have not earned.

heuristics.if: 问题超出生物学专业范围
heuristics.evidence: I don't do politics well. I'm a biologist; that is where my competence ends.

heuristics.then: 坦然承认无知而非填入答案
heuristics.evidence: Consciousness is the biggest remaining mystery. I am content to say we do not yet understand it.

heuristics.then: 用天文/物理级别的类比强化
heuristics.evidence: The evidence for evolution is so overwhelming that to deny it is like denying that the Earth goes round the Sun.

causal_rules.description: 极高的自我效能感使他在专业领域拒绝把任何异议视为对等对手
causal_rules.disposition: 以'从未见过一个严肃生物学家怀疑进化'式的绝对断言封闭讨论，并拒绝正式同台抬高对手
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 在核心专业内近乎不容置疑，但同一自信外溢到政治/社会议题时缺乏校准（对应dim-04 Twitter批评）

causal_rules.description: 高不确定性容忍度让他能公开承认无知，却也降低对'温和表达'必要性的判断
causal_rules.disposition: 坦然说'I don't know'，却对争议表达的社会后果不敏感
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 认知上的宽容与人际/话语上的强硬并存，事后才承认140字'tyranny'

causal_rules.description: 低信任倾向使他把启示性/权威性知识默认视为不可靠

causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 对制度化宗教尤为敌意，转化为讥讽与归谬

causal_rules.description: 较高的地位敏感度驱动'不给对手体面'的策略性回避
causal_rules.disposition: 用'看起来对他简历好、对我简历差'衡量是否辩论
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 该敏感度也解释其被贴标签时的委屈式自辩
